rationale: iter-62: res_norm group -> batch on iter-34 substrate. Headroom 0.5892 -> 0.6048 (+1.56pp). NEW RES-SLUG BEST, BREAKTHROUGH. BatchNorm with batch_size=1 actually wins over GroupNorm by a wide margin. Mechanism: BN tracks running statistics with momentum during training (effectively a per-sample normalization with smoothing across batches), and at validation uses those running stats (a kind of test-time mean-centering). On dual-domain pipelines where the per-batch distribution is consistent, this gives more useful normalization than GroupNorm's per-instance per-group stats.
